newsitem.title: UK: KS Biomedix signs licence deal with Roche.
newsitem.headline: KS Biomedix signs licence deal with Roche.

text.p: KS Biomedix said on Monday it signed a licence agreement with Hoffman-La Roche under which KS Biomedix will use its sheep monoclonal antibody (SMA) technology to develop a specific antibody for Roche.
The SMA will be used for treatment for a specific disease area and development work will be funded by Roche.
If a commercial treatment results, KS Biomedix will receive a royalty payment, the company said in a statement.
KS Biomedix said it was using SMA technology to produce antibodies for application in cancers as well as this work for Roche.
KS Biomedix chairman Basil Butler said the company saw collaborations as "the way to fully exploit its technology."
"We will continue to pursue further licence opportunities with other pharmaceutical companies," he added.
